fragments.before:
ServicesRepair & installationCosts & quoteFAQsBook a visit

What to do next

Tell us the fixture or appliance, its intended location and whether you want a repair, replacement or new connection. Product details help, but you do not need to dismantle plumbing or electrical equipment to report the job safely. We assess mounting, access and the existing connections before agreeing the work. The quote separates product supply, connection work and any additional plumbing or electrical tasks. A purchased product is not automatically compatible with the property.

Prepare clear work and approval information. Request an assessment and written quote.

Kitchen, bathroom and laundry installation services

Taps, sinks and bathroom fixtures

We assess fitting dimensions, mounting arrangements and accessible connections before replacing or connecting a fixture. A new fitting must suit the existing installation as well as the intended use. For a fault at an existing tap rather than an installation request, our tap and mixer repairs provide the more focused service.

Laundry and kitchen appliance connections

Washing-machine and other appliance connection requests need the product specifications and existing connections considered. Tell us whether the appliance has already been supplied, where it will be installed and whether old equipment needs disconnection within the job. Water, drainage and electrical connection requirements are distinct items in the proposed scope. For outlet work, see power-point installation and repairs.

Repairs around existing fixture connections

Visible water under a sink or near a fixture needs the source assessed before parts are selected. We identify whether the request concerns an accessible connection, the fixture itself or another plumbing issue. For a leaking cistern or flush problem, use toilet repairs; for temperature or hot-water supply faults, see hot-water repairs.

How fixture and appliance work is scoped and quoted

We review the selected product, installation location, accessible services and the result you need. The assessment establishes compatibility and any change required to existing pipework or wiring. Send the product details if you have already purchased equipment; we explain any installation requirement before assuming that it can be connected directly.

Coordinate connections with the wider renovation

Kitchen and bathroom work may need access planned around cabinetry, benchtops and other trades. We clarify what is ready for connection and what remains outside the agreed scope. Product supply, disconnection, installation and separate building work are identified rather than combined into an unclear package. This gives homeowners and property managers a usable basis for approval.

For authorised work, our team completes the agreed connections and checks the relevant installation. We explain the completed scope and any additional issue found, including whether a separate appliance service is needed. Where electrical fittings or outlets also need work, see our electrical repair and installation services and include these requirements in your booking.

Our Perth plumbing and electrical work is carried out by appropriately licensed trades. Licence details are available on request.

Safety: Leave existing electrical covers and connections intact and do not approach a leak near electrical equipment. For immediate danger, Call 000.

Dishwasher installation enquiries in Perth

For a dishwasher connection, tell us whether it is replacing an appliance in the same space or going into a new location. An existing cupboard opening does not establish that the water, drainage and electrical arrangements suit the new product. Share the model or installation sheet if available; you can enquire before buying.

The written scope should distinguish connection to suitable existing services from any new plumbing or fixed electrical work. Cabinetry alterations, product delivery, removing the old appliance and internal appliance repairs are not automatically part of a connection request. Confirm which tasks are accepted and who will handle any separate work.

  • Product model and intended kitchen position.
  • Existing appliance or a new location, with any known access restriction.
  • Who supplies the product and whether removal or another trade needs coordination.
  • Electrical outlet installation and compatibility
  • Leaks at an existing tap or connection
  • Discuss a dishwasher connection and written scope

Toilet installation or a cistern repair?

A toilet installation enquiry concerns the complete fixture and its connections. A running cistern, a faulty flush mechanism or a leaking component may need a repair rather than a new suite. Water rising in the bowl belongs with drainage assessment, not an assumption that the toilet must be replaced.

Before purchasing a replacement, discuss its dimensions, the existing connection position and access to the room. Confirm the accepted installation scope, product supply, removal of the old fixture and any separate floor, wall or connection work. A product-only price does not include every task needed at the property.

  • Toilet and cistern repair assessment
  • Blocked toilet and drain-clearing scope
  • Ask about a proposed toilet replacement

Fixture and appliance connections Perth: symptoms and service choices

Laundry overflow as a washing machine empties

The external waste connection or drainage may be restricted, but an appliance-related issue can also require attention. Report where water appears and whether other fixtures drain normally. Internal washing-machine repairs and plumbing connections are different scopes.

Repairing leaking washing-machine supply taps

Yes. We assess the supply tap or connection and agree the replacement or repair. A leaking supply tap is not a promise to repair internal appliance parts.

  • Drainage symptoms and clearing scope

Supply, removal and taking away the old unit

For dishwasher and toilet installations, we can supply the agreed product, remove the old unit and take it away as part of the installation package. The written quote identifies the selected product, connection work and any additional access or making good. Cabinet changes, bathroom renovation and internal appliance repairs are not automatically included.

  • Dishwasher supply and installation
  • Toilet supply and installation

fragments.before:
Fixture, Tap & Appliance Connection Services in Perth FAQs

Water connections, fixed wiring and appliance faults are different jobs

A dishwasher or washing machine can need water, drainage and electrical arrangements. Give the product details, intended position and accessible existing connections. Appliance internal repairs, cabinetry changes and specialist manufacturer work are not automatically included in a connection quote.

  • Tap and mixer repair or replacement
  • Electrical outlet and connection requirements
  • Perth plumbing repairs and installation scope
  • Dishwasher Installation & Connections Perth
  • Toilet Installation & Replacement Perth
Does appliance connection include repairing the appliance itself?

Not automatically. Plumbing connections, fixed electrical work and an internal appliance fault are different scopes. Describe the problem or proposed installation so the relevant work can be confirmed before booking.

Can a supplied appliance be connected without changing pipework or wiring?

That depends on its specifications, location and existing services. Ask the quote to separate the connection from any required pipe, cable, circuit or access work.

Is dishwasher installation the same as repairing a faulty dishwasher?

No. A connection request concerns the water, drainage and any agreed electrical arrangements. An internal appliance fault is a separate service. Describe the model, intended location and task so the accepted scope can be confirmed.

Can I buy a replacement toilet before checking the connections?

Discuss the proposed product first. Dimensions, the existing connection position and access can affect installation. Confirm product supply, removal and any separate connection or restoration work before treating a product price as the full installed cost.

Why does the laundry drain overflow when the washing machine empties?

A waste-connection restriction or drainage problem is possible; appliance faults require a separate scope. Read the explanation.

Can you replace leaking washing machine taps?

Yes. Repair or replacement of the water supply tap can be assessed separately from internal washing-machine repairs. Read the explanation.

Do I need detailed installation specifications before contacting you?

No. Tell us the fixture, equipment or upgrade you need and your Perth suburb. We assess the site and connections, confirm the requirements and qualified work arrangements and provide the written quote. Additional access is agreed with you first.

Can I send photos?

Photos are optional: email safely taken photos to maxinemaintenance.au@outlook.com. You can contact us without photos. Do not approach a hazard, remove covers or dismantle equipment to take a photo.

What information helps with a fixture or appliance connection enquiry?

Include the fixture or appliance, the room, the issue you have noticed, the property address and whether water, drainage or electrical supply is involved.

Can plumbing and electrical work be considered together?

Yes. Explain the complete requirement so the relevant plumbing and electrical work can be considered as part of the scope.

How is the work priced?

Pricing is based on the agreed scope, property access, materials or parts required and the condition confirmed through the enquiry or assessment process.

Does appliance connection include appliance servicing?

Connection work and repair of the appliance itself are different services. We identify the installation and connection tasks in the written quote and explain the boundary if the request involves an internal appliance fault.
